v: avya॰ hA--qagu । 1 ruzoktO 2 anunaye ca medi॰ ।
m: हम् ind. an exclamation expressive of anger or courtesy or respect (also हम् भो, or हम् भोः; cf. हंहो), Divyāv.; Jātakam.
a: हम् — ind. An exclamation expressive of anger, courtesy, or respect.

v: strI ham + BA--hamma--aN vA । gavAM DvanO trikA॰ pfzo॰ । hambApyatra hemaca॰ ।
m: हम्भा f. lowing or bellowing of cattle, MBh.; R. &c.
हम्भा—रव m. id. (-विराविन्, ‘making a lowing or bellowing sound’), MBh.
हम्भाय Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to low, bellow, MBh.
हमीआण N. of a place, Cat.
हमी-पुर्य mfn. coming or derived from Hamī-pura (cf. हम्मीर), Cat.
हम m. a partic. personification, Gaut.

s: strI, goDvaniH । tatparyyAyaH । hammA 2 reBaRam 3 । iti jawADaraH ॥ hamBA 4 ramBA 5 । iti hemacandraH ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 1 । 166 । 31 । “kroDaraktekzaRA sA gOrhambAravaGanasvanA । viSvAmitrasya tatsEnyaM vyadrAvayata sarbbaSaH ॥”)

m: हम्ब m. N. of a man, Rājat.
हम्म् cl. 1. P. हम्मति, to go (accord. to Pat. used in Surāṣṭra), Naigh. ii, 14; Dhātup. xiii, 24.

हम्मीर m. N. of a king of Śākambharī (who ruled from 1301-1365 A.D. and patronized Rāghava-deva, the grandfather of Śārṅgadhara, the author of the anthology, one stanza of which is attributed to him).
हम्मीर—चरित n. ‘Hammīra's deeds’, N. of a Mahā-kāvya by Naya-candra.

s: gatO । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰-para॰saka॰-sew .) madvayAntaH । hammati । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: gatO BvA॰ pa॰ saka॰ sew । hammati । ahammIt ।
